newsitem.title: USA: GPU sees 850 MW Pa. coal unit back Oct 21.
newsitem.headline: GPU sees 850 MW Pa. coal unit back Oct 21.

text.p: GPU Generation Inc scheduled its 850 Conemaugh 1 coal-fired unit back to operation Oct 21 after being shut Sept 5 for seasonal maintenance, the company said Monday.
The adjoining Conemaugh 2, also 850 MW, was operating at full output, said company spokeswoman Cindy Abrams.
The Conemaugh facility, in Indiana County, western Pennsylvania, is jointly owned by utility members of the Pennsylania-New Jersey-Maryland Interconnect power pool.
GPU Generation is a subsidiary of General Public Utilities Corp of Parsippany, N.J.
